scope: Judge web demo: React + Flask + synthetic ML + LP + scheduler/replay. Physical IoT demonstration remains separate.

frontend_tests.scope: Real Flask child process, judge/operator login and role-specific interfaces, scenario planning/replay/telemetry interactions.

frontend_build.warning: Main JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB after minification; non-blocking Vite warning.

judge_http.profile_scope: One process: startup, judge HTTP login, plan, replay, simulated telemetry, authorization rejection, logout. Development WSGI server; not Docker/Render load test.

visual_qa.note: Browser visual preview used a temporary local judge-session fixture outside the release. Real authentication was verified by HTTP and frontend tests. No such fixture or route is included in this package.

deployment.target: Render Docker 0.5c-512mb + 1GB persistent disk, Singapore, one instance

limits: No sensor calibration, actual delivery measurement, or physical actuation tested for this web release.
Memory profile is a single-process local measurement, not Docker or concurrent load verification.
Production judge password and public URL must be configured in the team hosting account.
